en-US: Added a Changelog page to Settings that lists the changes in every version.
The update dialog now shows what changed in the new version.
zh-CN: 设置中新增「更新日志」页面，列出每个版本的改动。
更新提示窗口会显示新版本改了什么。

en-US: Added exporting all application data as a ZIP archive.
Reorganized the Preferences and Window settings pages.
Refined the About page layout and unified menu item styles.
zh-CN: 新增把全部应用数据导出为 ZIP 压缩包。
重新整理了「偏好」和「窗口」设置页面。
优化了「关于」页面布局，统一了菜单项样式。

en-US: Added deleting notes, with an optional confirmation before deleting.
Pinote saves every open note before quitting.
When saving or closing a note fails, Pinote shows the problem with Retry, Close and Discard options instead of losing changes.
Context menus are now released when their note closes.
Improved the contrast of the delete menu item.
zh-CN: 新增删除便签，删除前可以选择是否确认。
Pinote 退出前会先保存所有打开的便签。
保存或关闭便签失败时，会显示问题并提供重试、关闭和放弃更改，不会悄悄丢失内容。
便签关闭后，它的右键菜单也会一并释放。
提高了删除菜单项的文字对比度。

en-US: Added multi-select and batch deletion in History.
Added removing notes from History without deleting the files.
History is now saved safely, accepts files with a UTF-8 BOM and can be updated while it is being read.
Refined the History layout and disabled the browser context menu in Settings.
zh-CN: 历史记录支持多选和批量删除。
新增只从历史记录中移除、不删除文件。
历史记录改为安全写入，支持带 UTF-8 BOM 的文件，读取时也能更新。
优化了历史记录的布局，设置窗口不再弹出浏览器自带的右键菜单。

en-US: Linux packages are now built on Ubuntu 22.04 so they run on more systems.
Improved the build and release process.
zh-CN: Linux 安装包改在 Ubuntu 22.04 上构建，能在更多系统上运行。
改进了构建和发布流程。

en-US: History previews now render Markdown and scroll long titles.
Added a tray tooltip and clarified the glass effect options; the default is now transparent.
Diagnostic reports now include system information and drag details.
Simplified the settings pages and fixed a settings saving loop.
Window dragging is smoother.
zh-CN: 历史记录预览会渲染 Markdown，长标题会滚动显示。
新增托盘图标提示，玻璃效果选项更清楚，默认改为透明。
诊断报告新增系统信息和拖动操作记录。
精简了设置页面，修复了设置被反复写入的问题。
拖动窗口更流畅。

en-US: Added Chinese and English interface languages.
Added revealing the note file from the context menu.
Redesigned Settings with sidebar icons, switches, number inputs and the native title bar.
zh-CN: 新增中文和英文界面。
右键菜单新增在文件夹中显示便签文件。
重新设计了设置窗口：侧边栏图标、开关、数字输入框和系统标题栏。

en-US: The dark theme now uses pure black.
Note window shortcuts are no longer swallowed by the editor.
Middle-clicking a note no longer pastes text.
zh-CN: 深色主题改为纯黑。
便签窗口的快捷键不再被编辑器拦截。
在便签上按鼠标中键不再粘贴文字。

en-US: Added exporting a diagnostic report.
zh-CN: 新增导出诊断报告。

en-US: Pinote now prompts at startup when a new version is available.
Pinote is now available on WinGet.
zh-CN: 启动时如果有新版本，会提示更新。
Pinote 可以通过 WinGet 安装。

en-US: Focusing a note no longer disturbs the saved state of hidden notes.
zh-CN: 聚焦便签时不再打乱已隐藏便签的记录。

en-US: Added bringing notes that are off screen back into view.
Hidden notes are no longer recorded as visible by mistake, so they stay hidden after a restart.
zh-CN: 新增把移出屏幕的便签移回可见区域。
隐藏的便签不会再被误记为显示状态，重启后仍保持隐藏。

en-US: Adjusted the padding of the app icon.
zh-CN: 调整了应用图标的边距。

en-US: Updated the app icons.
The shortcut that hides and shows visible notes remembers which notes it hid across restarts.
zh-CN: 更新了应用图标。
「切换显示便签」快捷键隐藏了哪些便签，重启后仍然记得。

en-US: Fixed a freeze that could happen when creating windows.
Reduced unnecessary log output.
zh-CN: 修复了新建窗口时可能卡住的问题。
减少了不必要的日志输出。

en-US: New note windows open in the center of the screen.
zh-CN: 新建的便签窗口显示在屏幕中央。

en-US: Added a shortcut for creating a new note.
Settings now show whether each global shortcut was registered, and handle shortcut conflicts.
zh-CN: 新增新建便签的快捷键。
设置中会显示全局快捷键是否注册成功，并能处理快捷键冲突。

en-US: Added a read-only mode for each note.
Added shortcuts for closing a window and showing all hidden windows, and updated the default shortcuts.
The context menu can follow the note's opacity.
Clicking the tray icon restores the most recently hidden note, or creates a new note when none is hidden.
When there is nothing to restore, visible notes come to the front and shake.
zh-CN: 每个便签可以单独设为只读。
新增关闭窗口、显示全部隐藏窗口的快捷键，并更新了默认快捷键。
右键菜单可以跟随便签的透明度。
点击托盘图标会恢复最近隐藏的便签；没有隐藏的便签时，会新建一个便签。
没有可以恢复的便签时，可见的便签会移到最前面并抖动提示。

en-US: Notes update when their files are changed by another app.
Opening a note that is already open brings its window to the front with a shake.
Added searchable note history and remembering the scroll position of each note.
Added glass effect settings for each platform and a blur strength control.
Added choosing the mouse button for dragging, a shortcut to toggle visible notes, and hiding notes from the taskbar.
zh-CN: 便签文件被其他应用修改后，内容会同步更新。
打开已经打开的便签时，会把它的窗口移到最前面并抖动提示。
新增可搜索的便签历史记录，并记住每个便签的滚动位置。
新增各平台的玻璃效果设置和模糊强度调节。
可以设置拖动用的鼠标按键，新增切换可见便签的快捷键，以及在任务栏中隐藏便签。

en-US: Added optional integration with the Explorer context menu and opening Markdown files with Pinote by default.
Notes created from the context menu keep the opacity and always-on-top state of the current note.
Note opacity can go from 0 to 100 percent, and the pinned indicator and scrollbar follow it.
Simplified the note context menu and placed it next to the cursor.
Hidden notes stay hidden after a restart.
zh-CN: 可选接入资源管理器右键菜单，以及把 Pinote 设为 Markdown 文件的默认打开方式。
从右键菜单新建的便签会沿用当前便签的透明度和置顶状态。
便签透明度可在 0 到 100% 之间调节，置顶标记和滚动条随之变化。
精简了便签右键菜单，并让它显示在光标旁边。
重启后隐藏的便签保持隐藏。

en-US: Added choosing the folder for new notes.
Added opening Markdown files from the command line.
Note windows are restored at the next launch with their position, size, pin state and visibility.
The restore shortcut brings back the most recently hidden note.
zh-CN: 可以设置新便签保存的文件夹。
支持从命令行打开 Markdown 文件。
下次启动时会恢复便签窗口的位置、大小、置顶和显示状态。
恢复快捷键会重新显示最近隐藏的那个便签。

en-US: Opacity and always-on-top are now set per note.
Resizing with the mouse wheel keeps the window around the cursor, and the modifier key is configurable.
Improved the always-on-top indicator.
zh-CN: 透明度和置顶改为每个便签单独设置。
用滚轮缩放窗口时以光标为中心，搭配的按键可以自定义。
改进了置顶状态的显示。

en-US: Added multiple note windows.
Added a context menu. Drag a window with the middle mouse button, middle-click to pin it, and hold Ctrl while scrolling to resize it.
Added typography and page spacing settings.
Redesigned Settings with a sidebar and removed the note title bar.
zh-CN: 支持同时打开多个便签窗口。
新增右键菜单。按住鼠标中键可以拖动窗口，单击中键可以切换置顶，按住 Ctrl 滚动滚轮可以缩放窗口。
新增文字排版和页面边距设置。
设置窗口改为侧边栏布局，便签窗口去掉了标题栏。

en-US: Added automatic updates.
Added a Settings window with launching at startup and customizable shortcuts.
Added window transparency effects and opacity control.
zh-CN: 新增自动更新。
新增设置窗口，可以设置开机启动和自定义快捷键。
新增窗口透明效果和不透明度调节。

en-US: Added space around the editor so the cursor does not overlap the window resize edges.
zh-CN: 编辑区四周留出边距，光标不再和窗口缩放边缘重叠。

en-US: First release: a floating Markdown note editor.
zh-CN: 首个版本：浮动的 Markdown 便签编辑器。
